key_point: an ignored game from a tiny team became a global hit, and they chose the original over a sequel
title: Among Us came out in 2018 and almost nobody played it. Its team of three nearly moved on.
caption: Among Us came out in 2018 and almost nobody played it. Its team of three nearly moved on. #gamefacts #didyouknow #gaming #amongus #innersloth #indiegames

instagram.caption:
Among Us launched in 2018 to almost no players. Innersloth, a team of three, nearly moved on.

In 2020 streamers found it, and within months it reached around half a billion monthly players.

Innersloth had already announced a sequel. They cancelled it so everyone who already owned the game would get the new content.
